independentReview.finding: Public ZIP export can return outputPath with no warning while producing a truncated invalid ZIP when FileHandle.write performs a legal partial write.
independentReview.rootCause: packages/library/src/service.ts #copyExportToPublicPath awaits FileHandle.write(chunk) once and ignores bytesWritten instead of looping until the full chunk is written.
independentReview.reproduction: Controlled FileHandle prototype forced one half-chunk write; manageLibrary export returned outputPath=true and warnings=[], but decodeZipArchive rejected the 542-byte output.
independentReview.additionalFinding: Public ZIP output path protection can be bypassed through a directory junction or symlink whose lexical path is outside protected roots but whose canonical target is inside protected legacy data.
independentReview.additionalRootCause: service.ts validates only the normalized lexical output path before createExclusiveFile follows existing linked directory components.
independentReview.additionalReproduction: A temporary apparently-safe junction targeting protected-legacy accepted export.zip, returned outputPath with no warning, and created the file inside protected-legacy.
independentReview.requiredOwnerTask: Reopen task 5.1 within its existing service.ts/conformance-test scope, add a write-all root fix and regression test, then rerun task 5.2 clean conformance and issue a new delivery SHA.
